## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Reporting and printing: the `ReportProvider` SPI and the in-memory `ReportRegistry` (a duplicate code fails
startup), the endpoints `/api/v1/report/definitions`, `/{code}/run` and `/{code}/export?format=csv|json|pdf|xlsx|docx|html`
(the printed formats when JasperReports is on the classpath), the automatic permission `<MODULE>:REPORT:<CODE>`,
the row cap `erp.core.report.max-export-rows`, and `PrintApi` for designed documents (`reports/<module>/<name>.jrxml`,
`_ar` variants, BEANS or tenant-safe JDBC data, tenant templates through `PrintTemplateSource`). Every render is
audited (`PRINT`). Since 1.6.0 (PF-004) also the bank payment file export: `PaymentFileExportApi` (`listFormats`,
`validateAccount`, `export`) writes ISO 20022 `pain.001.001.03` / `.09` or a bank CSV layout defined as data
(`REPORT_PAYMENT_LAYOUT`, administered under `REPORT_PAYMENT_LAYOUTS` at `/api/v1/report/payment-layouts`), validates
IBAN / LOCAL accounts, amounts and texts first, stores the file PRIVATE through FILE and is idempotent per tenant key.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
For every list export (one `ReportProvider` per list screen — "one export method"), every tabular report and
every printed document (invoice, voucher, statement through `PrintApi` + `PrintResponses.toResponseEntity`).
Extra parameters every document receives: a `PrintParameterContributor`; a veto beyond the permission: a
`PrintAuthorizationHook`.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
@Component
public class ShopOrderListReport implements ReportProvider {
    public static final String AUTHORITY = ReportAuthorities.of("SHOP", "SHOP_ORDER_LIST");   // SHOP:REPORT:SHOP_ORDER_LIST
    public String code() { return "SHOP_ORDER_LIST"; }
    public String moduleCode() { return "SHOP"; }
    public String titleAr() { return "قائمة الطلبات"; }
    public String titleEn() { return "Order list"; }
    public List<ReportParam> params() { return List.of(ReportParam.lookup("status", "SHOP_ORDER_STATUS", false, "الحالة", "Status")); }
    @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority(T(com.acme.shop.report.ShopOrderListReport).AUTHORITY)")
    public ReportResult run(Map<String, Object> params, Pageable page) {
        String status = ReportSpecs.text(params, "status");                        // null when absent
        Page<Order> rows = repository.findByStatusCode(status, page);               // JPA: tenant-filtered
        return new ReportResult(COLUMNS, rows.map(mapper::toRow).getContent(), Map.of(), rows.getTotalElements());
    }
}

// a designed document
PrintResult pdf = printApi.render(PrintRequest.builder().templatePath("shop/order").format(PrintFormat.PDF)
    .data(List.of(orderView)).parameters(Map.of("ORDER_NO", order.getOrderNo())).locale(locale)
    .fileName("order-" + order.getOrderNo()).permission(ShopPermissions.PERM_SHOP_ORDERS_PRINT).build());
return PrintResponses.toResponseEntity(pdf);

// a bank payment file (PF-004): validate, build, store PRIVATE in the caller's tenant, idempotent per key
PaymentInstruction instruction = new PaymentInstruction(batch.getNo(), batch.getExecutionDate(), "SAR",
    new PaymentInstruction.Party(company.getName(), AccountRef.iban(company.getIban(), company.getBic())),
    batch.getLines().stream().map(line -> new PaymentInstruction.Transaction(line.getRef(), line.getAmount(),
        new PaymentInstruction.Party(line.getPayeeName(), AccountRef.iban(line.getPayeeIban())), line.getText())).toList());
PaymentFileResult file = paymentFileExportApi.export(instruction, "pain.001.001.03", "payout-" + batch.getId());
batch.recordFile(file.fileDocumentId());                       // the module keeps the lifecycle; the core keeps no payment state
DownloadGrant grant = filePrivateStoreApi.issueDownloadToken(file.fileDocumentId());   // the module's permission guards it
AccountCheck check = paymentFileExportApi.validateAccount(AccountRef.iban(form.getIban()));   // at data entry
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
